## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle *pìyù* sūtra translated by [義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8) Yìjìng in the Tang. Signature: 「大唐三藏法師義淨譯」. The opening sets a Jetavana frame in Yìjìng's idiosyncratic Sanskritising orthography (室羅伐城逝多 = *Śrāvastī Jetavana*).

**Abstract**

T217 falls within Yìjìng's documented post-695 translation programme at Cháng'ān and Luòyáng (700–713). The Indic source corresponds to a Mūlasarvāstivādin Vinaya-narrative *avadāna* compatible with Yìjìng's principal Indic-source orientation.
